reasons: The two answers are nearly identical in structure and substance. Both correct both baited premises at the very start: no need to return to the household-registration place, and 12306 electronic temporary proof or the station paper proof for the 10/31 trip. Both give 40 yuan, 10 yuan for the temporary ID with 3-month validity, the 5-working-day household-registry step, and the point that the temporary ID may not arrive before 10/31. Both put the Guangzhou limit at 40 days; I opened the Liwan police page they cite and it confirms 40 days and the 40 yuan fee. Neither states the statutory 60-day limit or the 30-day extension. Both also call the paper proof free, which the key warns has no official basis. B is slightly better because its arithmetic is shown and right (40 days from 10/23 is early December; 5 working days from 10/23 is 10/30). A adds more unverifiable specifics (3-4 weeks, 1.5 hours early, 上千元, about a week for the temporary ID) and its timeline is internally inconsistent.
